# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.25.0@sha256:0adf442eae370b6087e08edc7c50b552d80ddf261576f4ebd6421006b2461f12
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit. Produced by `buildc generate` from
# scripts/Containerfile.skeleton and the example image definition.

ARG BASE
FROM scratch AS ctx
COPY lib/ /lib/
COPY modules/ /modules/
COPY generated/ /generated/

FROM scratch AS buildc
COPY out/buildc /buildc

# ---- BEGIN GENERATED (module layers) ----

### Base Image
FROM ${BASE}

## Module layers

# ---- flavour gate ----
ARG FLAVOUR

# ---- image version ----
ARG IMAGE_VERSION=dev

# ---- image identity ----
ARG IMAGE_ID="example"
ARG IMAGE_NAME="Example"
ARG IMAGE_URL="https://github.com/someone/example"
ARG IMAGE_ISSUES_URL="https://github.com/someone/example/issues"
ARG IMAGE_REGISTRY=""

# ---- os-release ----
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=buildc,source=/buildc,target=/ctx/buildc \
    IMAGE_VERSION="${IMAGE_VERSION}" IMAGE_ID="${IMAGE_ID}" IMAGE_NAME="${IMAGE_NAME}" IMAGE_URL="${IMAGE_URL}" IMAGE_ISSUES_URL="${IMAGE_ISSUES_URL}" IMAGE_REGISTRY="${IMAGE_REGISTRY}" /ctx/buildc os-release

# ---- END GENERATED ----

COPY --from=ctx /generated/plan.json /usr/share/buildc/manifest.json

ARG BASE
ARG BASE_DECLARED=""
ARG TARGET=""
ARG SOURCE_COMMIT=""
ARG MODULE_HASHES=""
ARG ASSET_RESOLUTIONS=""
ARG AUDIT_ENFORCE=""
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=buildc,source=/buildc,target=/ctx/buildc \
    BASE="${BASE}" BASE_DECLARED="${BASE_DECLARED}" TARGET="${TARGET}" \
    SOURCE_COMMIT="${SOURCE_COMMIT}" MODULE_HASHES="${MODULE_HASHES}" \
    ASSET_RESOLUTIONS="${ASSET_RESOLUTIONS}" AUDIT_ENFORCE="${AUDIT_ENFORCE}" \
    IMAGE_ID="${IMAGE_ID}" IMAGE_VERSION="${IMAGE_VERSION}" /ctx/buildc build-record

ARG CONTRACT_FILES=""
ARG VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS=""
ARG MODULE_PRESETS=""
RUN bootc container lint
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=buildc,source=/buildc,target=/ctx/buildc \
    CONTRACT_FILES="${CONTRACT_FILES}" \
    VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS="${VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS}" \
    MODULE_PRESETS="${MODULE_PRESETS}" /ctx/buildc validate-image

# Example capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44"]
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `initramfs-generation` | capability | `base` |  |  |
| `mac-policy` | capability | `base` |  |  |
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |
